model.description: S33 RE-SCOPE (Tron device-QA IMG_4771 + PO-gap-vision-vs-delivered.md): the never-delivered CORE. R32.4/5/6 gated GREEN but verified STRUCTURE (buildDiagramSvg unit / add-view endpoint / tap-fires), NEVER the VISUAL @390 interaction - Tron has never seen drag/tap an item -> a SELECTABLE, MOVABLE SVG class box with attribute/method/property compartments on a pan/zoom canvas, like a real diagram editor. Architect measure-first (9fc7bd402): the box+compartment logic EXISTS (buildBox diagram-view-model.ts:24 + buildDiagramSvg :91, unit-tested); the MISS is (1) MOVABLE boxes NOT built (box-click only selects, static <g>, no drag-to-move); (2) the diagram is a TRANSIENT drawer detail, not a reachable persistent canvas; (3) the gates never proved the visual @390 loop. FILL (REUSE, assemble the editor): reachable diagrams-folder->Diagram canvas + drop->VISIBLE compartment box (resolver populates members) + ★MOVABLE box-drag (NEW POST /api/model/diagram/move-view, MODEL_STORE, touch+mouse, disambiguated from RbPanZoom-pan) + selectable (exists) + folders diagrams/puml/ts with DRY filename-only labels resolve-to-file-for-EDIT + ACTION BAR reuse rb-strip/rb-compartment (my S31 CONCEPT primitives, BUILT) NAMED Add-Diagram/Compile-PUML->SVG + M2-instance SVG (buildBox) + R32.6 edges. INV-S33V-1 visible / 2 movable / 3 selectable / 4 isolation. ★ GATE POSTURE = @390 Tron REAL interaction, SCREENSHOT+PIXEL (drag->SEE the movable selectable box), NOT endpoint/structure. SUPERSEDES the old P3f-1 structure-framing of this req. Chain: UC diagram.render + diagram.moveView -> Class rb-diagram-detail (+ server move-view) -> Method(s) -> Impl -> Test (mints on build; the new build = move-view + box-drag + reachable canvas + action-bar mount). Compile->TypeScript codegen stays split to R33.4 (deferred).
